text:
```yaml
name: Lint Objective-C Code

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: macos-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Xcode
      uses: apple-actions/xcode-setup@v1
      with:
        version: '13'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        brew install llvm jq xcpretty

    - name: Generate compile_commands.json
      run: |
        xcodebuild clean build -workspace Sentry.xcworkspace -scheme Sentry -configuration Release -derivedDataPath .derivedData -showBuildSettings | grep -E '^ *CLANG_CXX_LANGUAGE_STANDARD=' > .clang-tidy

    - name: Run clang-tidy
      run: |
        find . -name "*.m" -o -name "*.mm" | xargs clang-tidy --checks='-*,google-objc-avoid-nsobject-new' --config-file=.clang-tidy --format-style=LLVM --header-filter='.*' --quiet

    - name: Check for [new] usage
      run: |
        git diff HEAD^ HEAD -- '*.m' '*.mm' | grep '\[new\]' && echo "Found [new] usage. Please replace with [[alloc] init]." && exit 1 || true

    - name: Update AGENTS.md
      run: |
        echo "- Avoid using `[ClassName new]`. Instead use `[[ClassName alloc] init]`." >> AGENTS.md
```
